subject: Idea for Sailing Orlando
body:
Hi,

I came across Sailing Orlando and spent some time looking through the experience. What stood out most was the sunset tour format — a private two-hour sail on Lake Fairview at golden hour is one of the most visually distinct experiences in the area, and it does not look like anything else in Orlando content.

From what I saw, the experience already has a strong foundation, but I think the content could lean more into the feel of being on the water as the light changes — the movement, the quiet, the contrast — so the viewer understands what it actually feels like to be out there.

I create luxury travel UGC built around that kind of storytelling. The concept I had would build from departure into golden hour on the lake, keeping it clean and refined so it feels premium rather than just scenic.

Happy to send over the full angle I had in mind for Sailing Orlando.

Best,
Malachi
